name: Web address
purpose: names one page on the web so exactly that no other page in the world has the same one
note: The address bar and the search box are one field in every modern browser, which is why „ins Internet gehen" and „googeln" have become the same gesture — and why many people have never typed an address in their lives

name: Resource identifier
purpose: names a thing, whether or not it says where to find it — the wider idea that a web address is one case of
note: The pair people cannot keep apart, and the difference is one word: a URI says WHAT, a URL also says WHERE. Every URL is a URI; almost nobody needs the distinction and almost everybody has seen both letters

name: Domain
purpose: names who a place on the web belongs to — the part of an address between the slashes and the first single slash
note: People say „Website" for it and the two are not the same: the domain is the name, the website is what stands at it. One can be sold without the other, which is a whole industry

name: Top-level domain
purpose: is the last part of a domain — the dot-something that says which register the name was bought from
note: „.de heißt deutsche Firma" is the common reading and it is not true: anybody may buy one, and a .com may sit in Hamburg. The ending says where the name was registered, never where anything is

name: IP address
purpose: is the number a device is reachable at in a network — what a domain is looked up to arrive at
note: The number under every name. A domain exists because people do not remember numbers, which is the entire reason the two are separate things

name: Socket
purpose: is one end of a connection between two programs — the point where one plugs into the network
note: Filed as a protocol by habit and it is not one: a socket is an endpoint, a protocol is the agreement about what is said once two are joined

name: VOIP
purpose: is telephoning over the internet instead of over a telephone line
note: Said as if it were a protocol; the protocols under it are SIP, which arranges the call, and RTP, which carries the voice. The architect named the mechanism behind such words: one reaches for the roomier drawer because it is quicker

name: Local network
purpose: is the network inside one building — the devices that can reach each other without going out to the internet
example: the router, the printer and two laptops in one flat
note: Not a protocol and not a thing you can buy: it is the BOUNDARY, the answer to „which machines are on my side of the router?". Ethernet and WLAN are the two ways of being on it
